summary: Itaú Unibanco filed a Form 6-K furnishing summarized minutes of its Fiscal Council meeting held on August 4, 2026. The council nominated Eduardo Hiroyuki Miyaki as Chairman and Cláudio José Coutinho Arromatte as alternate, and issued a routine opinion on the company's January–June 2026 financial statements, which received an unqualified report from PricewaterhouseCoopers. No transaction, strategic action, or special-situation event is present. This is a routine corporate governance and periodic disclosure filing by a Brazilian bank and does not correspond to any special-situation category.
